recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a blonde woman with red lips, partially obscured on the left by soft, out-of-focus light orbs (bokeh), featuring a structured typographic block in the upper-left quadrant containing condensed sans-serif lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: The sharp focus of the right eye balances the soft bokeh on the left.
The vibrant red of the lips echoes the red primary text on the left.
The vertical alignment of the text block creates a hard edge against the organic curves of the face.
The warm skin tones contrast with the cool, hazy highlights of the background.
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up framing of the face
Prominent use of out-of-focus light circles (bokeh)
Asymmetrical text placement in the upper left

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face occupies the right two-thirds of the frame at a large scale, slightly tilted.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's red lips and the bold red vertical text on the left serve as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold red text, moves right to the subject's eyes, then down to the lips, following the diagonal tilt of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left third is filled with atmospheric bokeh, providing a soft background for the text block.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm peach and beige skin tones define the primary surface area.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black text provides a sharp structural contrast against the soft background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant crimson red is used for the lips and the primary name text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red accents against a muted, low-contrast pastel background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm neutrals, black, and one shade of red

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' has a high horizontal bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Thin black rectangular frame enclosing part of the text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed verticality of the main title.
Matches the high x-height and narrow profile of mid-century display types.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a blonde woman with 1960s makeup and red lipstick. The left side of the frame should be filled with soft, warm-toned bokeh light orbs, creating a hazy, atmospheric negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-condensed sans-serif text in the upper left. Use red for the primary name and black for the title. Enclose the title in a thin black box. Add a small-scale tracklist below in black uppercase text.

verificationChecks: Is the left side dominated by bokeh?
Are the lips a vibrant red?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for accents
Tightness of the text framing box
mustRedesign: Specific artist names or copyrighted song titles
The record label logo in the top right
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's eyes.
Check that the red in the text matches the red of the lips.
Verify the 'extra-condensed' nature of the font.
Confirm the bokeh looks like optical lens blur, not a digital filter.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Bokeh Negative Space + Condensed Sans-Serif Typography Block
